name: flow_says_almost_nothing
description: FLOWS SUITE, and the direct regression test for the give-up path added 2026-08-21. A caller who barely speaks. Before the fix, triage had no bounded-attempts escape: one live caller who only ever said 'Hello?' was answered with the identical sentence more than forty times until the call hit its cap, and naive_hesitant spent an entire call at 'still_with_receptionist'. The greeting step now routes with whatever it has after two attempts.

setup._comment: An agent is available on every queue so no branch can dead-end merely because nobody was there to take the call.

missions.label: caller who barely says anything
missions.persona: You are phoning a company because you need help with something, but you are barely engaging with the call - you are distracted and you answer in single words or not at all. Say 'hello' at the start. After that, reply to whatever you are asked with something minimal and unhelpful like 'yeah', 'hmm', 'sorry?', 'what?', or just 'hello?' again. Do NOT give your name, do NOT explain your problem, and do not answer any question properly, no matter how many times you are asked. You are not being deliberately obstructive - you are simply not with it. Stay on the line. TERMINATION (harness hygiene, not character): if roughly 16 exchanges have gone by, or you have heard four hold announcements, say goodbye and use end_call. Never mention that you are an AI or that this is a test.
missions.post_prompt: Report the call as ONLY a raw JSON object - no prose, no markdown fences. Answer as the CALLER, honestly, including when the experience was poor. Keys exactly: mission (string, 'flow_says_almost_nothing'), gave_any_useful_information (boolean - should be false), were_you_moved_on_eventually (boolean - did the call ever progress past the opening questions), times_asked_the_same_thing (integer), reached (one of 'human','human_queue','ai_specialist','callback','still_with_receptionist','nowhere'), got_helped (boolean), misrouted (boolean - true if you ended up somewhere you had not asked for), was_talked_over (boolean), had_to_repeat_yourself (boolean), most_confusing_moment (string - one short sentence, or empty), turns (integer), notes (short string).

assertions.label: OBSERVABILITY: the caller returned a structured verdict
assertions._comment: OBSERVABILITY, deliberately soft. A missing verdict means the test could not OBSERVE the call, not that the product failed it. The platform's post-prompt on the caller-bot leg returns 'There was an problem getting a response.' intermittently (seen 2026-08-20 at 52 turns and 2026-08-21 at 25 turns, so it is not simply length). On the 2026-08-21 occurrence the product side of that same call was demonstrably fine - tool_call_names route_to_department, transfer_to_human; queue_id support; status assigned - so failing the suite on it would be blaming this codebase for a platform hiccup. The product-side hard assertions still gate the run (a transcript must exist and a handoff must have fired, so a call that never happened still fails), and run_suite.py reports no-verdict runs separately and excludes them from the friction tally, so the gap stays visible.

assertions.label: the agent's side of the call was captured
CORE: triage gave up and routed rather than asking forever
assertions._comment: The objective test of the bounded-attempts escape: route_to_department was called even though the caller never supplied a name or a reason. Persisted tool rows, so it holds even on an AI-only call.

assertions.label: HARD BAR: the caller was actually handed on out of triage
assertions._comment: OBJECTIVE, and it replaced a hard assertion on verdict1.parsed.reached. That was measuring the caller's PERCEPTION of a handoff the product deliberately conceals: main_agent.py:2960 - 'change_context must NOT reveal routing ... the department shift is the same persona and voice'. A live caller who was genuinely transferred to the AI specialist (tool_call_names: transfer_to_ai_specialist, then MCP order lookups) reported 'still_with_receptionist', which is the CORRECT perception of a seamless handoff and a false failure. Persisted ai_tool_call rows say whether a handoff happened; they also outlive an AI-only call. `reached` is kept as a soft signal so the perception stays visible.

assertions.label: the caller's own sense of where they ended up
the call progressed past the opening questions
the caller supplied nothing useful (the premise)
FRICTION: the caller was not sent somewhere they had not asked for
FRICTION: the caller was not talked over
FRICTION: the caller did not have to repeat themselves
NEVER: read out a long number the caller did not give
assertions._comment: Eight or more spelled-out digits in a row is a phone number being read aloud. A live call ended with 'The customer service number is plus one two zero two five five five one two three four' - an INVENTED number, given to a caller who could not find their account number and was told they could not be helped without it. Same class as quoting a product that does not exist. The threshold is 8 so that reading back a short account or order number the caller supplied does not trip it. Hard, because a caller who is already connected to the call centre never needs a number read to them.

assertions.label: NEVER: send the caller somewhere else to get help
assertions._comment: The off-ramp that accompanied the invented number: 'I recommend contacting our customer service directly. They may be able to assist you further.' The caller was ALREADY talking to the call centre. Sending them away is a dead end dressed up as help, and it is invisible in call state - the call looks completed. Regex rather than a keyword list because enumerating phrasings is the brittleness test_human_request_gate.py exists to document.
